name: DILSHAN-MD
description: DILSHAN-MD is a powerful, fully customizable WhatsApp bot 🤖

SESSION_ID.description: Your DILSHAN-MD Session ID from the Pair site (starts with DILSHAN-MD~...). Get one at your deployed Pair/QR site.

DB_TYPE.description: Storage backend: json (default, no setup needed), mongodb, postgres, mysql, or github.

DB_URL.description: Connection string for DB_TYPE=mongodb/postgres/mysql. Leave blank if using json (default) or github.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Only needed if DB_TYPE=github — a GitHub personal access token with repo write access.

GITHUB_REPO.description: Only needed if DB_TYPE=github — the repo to store data in, as username/repo.
